directive.quote: finish the film repository port so the repo can be retired: settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door

preserve: the stores are read as q.py read them: the asset index's matrices and ids, the timed frames cut to the shorter of the two files, the results store's picture-vectors frames of the right size with their path and time, and the namespace store's live aliases as each video's b2 id; every source opened read-only
allowed_deltas: the stores are arguments (--asset-index, --ssd-index, --expansion-results, --namespace, --kind) instead of what the place reports in its environment
each store is written as a vector set (items.jsonl, vectors.npy, vector-set.json) instead of being searched here; the search is findSimilarAcross
the readable names of the asset index are read for every item, not only for the hits
banned_substitutions: a person's index folders, drives or film folders written into the code
